svg.title: The cartographer, painted by Claude Opus 5.5 in Kleki
svg.desc: A three-quarter portrait of an invented elderly cartographer: brass spectacles, grey beard, knitted scarf, a pencil behind the ear, lamp light and a map behind. 13049 input actions over 169 minutes, 112 screenshots, owner kleki-opus.

g.text: a pencil behind the ear, lamp light
